Directions: Select a word or the group of words that is the most opposite in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her son tried to __inveigle__ her into giving him the money for a car.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dissuade**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In​veigle:** To persuade someone in a clever or sneaky way, especially by using flattery or deceit. (किसी को मनाने के लिए, विशेष रूप से चापलूसी या छल का उपयोग करके।) 

 
 
• **Example**: "*Her son tried to **inveigle** her into giving him the money for a car."*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words.**__

__
 
• **Persuade**: To convince someone to do something by giving them reasons or arguments. (किसी को कारण या तर्क देकर किसी को कुछ करने के लिए राजी करना।)

 
 
• **Example**: *"He tried to **persuade** her to buy a new car."*
 
 
 
• **Dissuade**: To persuade someone not to do something. (किसी को कुछ न करने के लिए राजी करना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *"She tried to **dissuade** him from quitting his job."*
 
 
 
• **Wheedle**: To persuade someone by using flattery or deceit. (चापलूसी या छल से किसी को राजी करना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *"He **wheedled** his way into getting a raise."*
 
 
 
• **Cajole**: To persuade someone by being kind or flattering. (किसी की चापलूसी करके उसे मनाना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *"She **cajoled** her friends into coming to her party."*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,*** the correct answer is **Option 2, i.e., Dissuade.***
